items.title: Surya Yantra (Sun)
items.summary: A geometric yantra traditionally used to focus worship and support Sun's significations.
items.effects: Traditionally installed and worshipped to strengthen Sun's themes, alongside (not instead of) that planet's mantra. Placed facing east; traditionally energized and worshipped at sunrise.
items.placement_note: Placed facing east; traditionally energized and worshipped at sunrise.

items.title: Chandra Yantra (Moon)
items.summary: A geometric yantra traditionally used to focus worship and support Moon's significations.
items.effects: Traditionally installed and worshipped to strengthen Moon's themes, alongside (not instead of) that planet's mantra. Placed facing north or kept near where one sleeps; associated with calming the mind.
items.placement_note: Placed facing north or kept near where one sleeps; associated with calming the mind.

items.title: Mangal Yantra (Mars)
items.summary: A geometric yantra traditionally used to focus worship and support Mars's significations.
items.effects: Traditionally installed and worshipped to strengthen Mars's themes, alongside (not instead of) that planet's mantra. Placed facing south; traditionally paired with Hanuman worship on Tuesdays.
items.placement_note: Placed facing south; traditionally paired with Hanuman worship on Tuesdays.

items.title: Budh Yantra (Mercury)
items.summary: A geometric yantra traditionally used to focus worship and support Mercury's significations.
items.effects: Traditionally installed and worshipped to strengthen Mercury's themes, alongside (not instead of) that planet's mantra. Placed facing north; associated with clarity of communication and intellect.
items.placement_note: Placed facing north; associated with clarity of communication and intellect.

items.title: Guru Yantra (Jupiter)
items.summary: A geometric yantra traditionally used to focus worship and support Jupiter's significations.
items.effects: Traditionally installed and worshipped to strengthen Jupiter's themes, alongside (not instead of) that planet's mantra. Placed facing north-east, the most auspicious direction for Jupiter; worshipped on Thursdays.
items.placement_note: Placed facing north-east, the most auspicious direction for Jupiter; worshipped on Thursdays.

items.title: Shukra Yantra (Venus)
items.summary: A geometric yantra traditionally used to focus worship and support Venus's significations.
items.effects: Traditionally installed and worshipped to strengthen Venus's themes, alongside (not instead of) that planet's mantra. Placed facing south-east; associated with relationships and material comfort.
items.placement_note: Placed facing south-east; associated with relationships and material comfort.

items.title: Shani Yantra (Saturn)
items.summary: A geometric yantra traditionally used to focus worship and support Saturn's significations.
items.effects: Traditionally installed and worshipped to strengthen Saturn's themes, alongside (not instead of) that planet's mantra. Placed facing west; traditionally installed and worshipped on Saturdays, often alongside Hanuman.
items.placement_note: Placed facing west; traditionally installed and worshipped on Saturdays, often alongside Hanuman.

items.title: Rahu Yantra (Rahu)
items.summary: A geometric yantra traditionally used to focus worship and support Rahu's significations.
items.effects: Traditionally installed and worshipped to strengthen Rahu's themes, alongside (not instead of) that planet's mantra. Placed facing south-west; associated with Durga or serpent (Nag) worship in different regional traditions.
items.placement_note: Placed facing south-west; associated with Durga or serpent (Nag) worship in different regional traditions.

items.title: Ketu Yantra (Ketu)
items.summary: A geometric yantra traditionally used to focus worship and support Ketu's significations.
items.effects: Traditionally installed and worshipped to strengthen Ketu's themes, alongside (not instead of) that planet's mantra. Placed facing south-west; associated with Ganesha worship in most traditions.
items.placement_note: Placed facing south-west; associated with Ganesha worship in most traditions.
